flags.title: Your bill is higher than what your EOB says you owe
flags.explanation: The bill asks for $2,760.00, but your insurer's EOB lists your responsibility as $560.00. Out-of-network providers can sometimes bill the difference, but not for emergency care or for anesthesia, radiology, labs and assistant surgeons at an in-network facility (No Surprises Act). Ask the billing office to explain or correct the difference.

flags.title: Possible surprise bill: out-of-network anesthesia
flags.explanation: Your EOB marks this anesthesia as out-of-network. If it was given at an in-network hospital or surgery center, the federal No Surprises Act says you only owe in-network cost-sharing and the provider can't bill you the rest. Learn more at cms.gov/nosurprises. We don't know your in-network cost-sharing, so we show the full amount.
